核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 先保留 raw_evidence，再生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks 表示未拆分前的 stored memory block，语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 memory_text 为 atomic memories。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory 的 text 必须是第三人称，evidence 保留 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. accepted=true 时至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，包含 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。
10. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 如果无法构造至少 1 个 B/C，输出 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: "Noticed swollen taste buds v shape, red swollen bumps back of tongue, taking mono. Normal? I have had mono since two months ago & recently got tested again for anything else. Everything was negative. But I looked at my tounge one day & my taste buds was swollen in a v shape in the back of my tounge. & I looked further back and there is a ton of red swollen bumps is this normal? What is it? & there is kind of white a round the v shape."
doctor_answer: "Hello , Thanks for writing in. The swelling of taste buds may be due to ulceration/inflammation of tastebuds. Avoid anxiety and stressful works. vITAMIN rich fruits and plenty of fluids can be taken. Avoid intake of hot/spicy/salty food items. mAINtain good oral hygiene. Take vitamin becosules,iron,folic acid supplements. Please do get clinical check up by a dentist. hope this suffices."

1. 患有单核细胞增多症（mono）已经两个月。（C/B？对于当前舌头症状，mono 可能是相关病史，但医生回答中并未直接针对 mono 进行治疗，而是当作一般的舌乳头炎。不过作为病史，它可能影响免疫状态。算 B 或 C。这里定为 B，支持性背景，或者 C，如果是免疫抑制相关。其实舌后部 V 型排列的肿大乳头通常是轮廓乳头（circumvallate papillae），是正常的解剖结构，发炎时会更明显。mono 病史可能让患者焦虑。定为 B：局部支持，解释症状时考虑免疫/感染背景，但不改变“可能是正常结构或轻度炎症”的主干。）

1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。

6. atomic memory text 必须是第三人称 stored memory，evidence 保留 raw evidence。

11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 先写去背景化 question。移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留 raw_evidence，再生成 stored memory。raw_evidence 是原始证据，memory_text 是第三人称、总结式、去口语化、可独立理解的规范化记忆。
3. memory_blocks 表示未拆分前的 stored memory block。语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 把每条 memory_text 拆成 atomic memories。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory 的 text 必须是第三人称 stored memory，evidence 保留对应 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. accepted=true 时必须至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，并在 memories 中包含至少 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。只允许补 hard A。

user_defined_params.raw_question: After a fall that hurt her right thigh my mother bruised at the site of the injury and under the knee. the bruise remained for a couple weeks then subsided but now she feels like a hard knot is all the way inside where the injury was. What could that be and how could it be treated
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi. Welcome to Chat Doctor . I have gone through your query and can understand your concern. As per your complaint it seems that due to injury caused by fall there has been inflammation of the soft tissues and also ruptured blood vessels leading to swelling, bruising and hematoma formation. As the inflammation subsides the swelling resolves while the disintegration of blood from soft tissues can resolve bruising. While at times the Hematoma gets encapsulated and localized and becomes a firm lump that can take a longer time of about months to resolve. In your case if only seems to be the case. You can do alternate warm and cool compresses over the lump 2 to 3 times a day. Apply Thrombophob gel that will help in faster disintegration of the clot. In case if the lump does not regress in a month consult a General Physician and get evaluated. Hope this information helps. Thanks and regards. Chat Doctor.

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留 raw_evidence，生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks：未拆分前的 stored memory block，语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。

user_defined_params.raw_question: For several weeks I have had left hip pain that increases with sitting. I have abdominal pain in the pelvic region as well. Sometimes I have to use a cane to walk. The pain is in my left leg to my foot sometimes and the entire side becomes stiff sometimes. I can often walk it out but I have to be careful bending, lifting, sitting, or squatting. I have had a total hysterectomy over a year ago.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello, Thanks for the query to Chat Doctor. Forum. I would come up with these possibilities for this severe pain in the left hip joint, This includes. 1 Pinched nerve (sciatica) , diagnosis can be confirmed by C T scan and X-ray of lumbar sacrum region. As you mentioned that there is severe pain radiating to leg, foot, as all these symptoms are an indication of sciatica nerve involvement (pinched)2 Degeneration of head of femur. Diagnosis can be confirmed by C T scan & X-ray of head of femur.3 Osteoporosis, diagnosis can be confirmed by blood examination and bone density test.4 Osteoarthritis, diagnosis can be confirmed by C B C and E SR. Hysterectomy have not any role in this pain. In my opinion consult an orthopedic surgeon and get his opinion. Good luck.

user_defined_params.raw_question: I just checked my blood pressure at a grocery store and the machine said 168 systolic and 68 diastolic. Im 20 years old! Im not over weight or have any medical conditions except for a slight heart murmur I was born with. But I did suffer a pretty bad panic attack a few days ago, because of finals and stuff. Im still kind of stressed, because Im worried about my health and such. Should I be worried?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello, You shouldn't be worried at this stage, you should buy one BP apparatus and monitor your blood pressure. Of your blood pressure is high persistently then you will some investigation. Yes stress and exertion can certainly raise blood pressure. You should have a healthy lifestyle like avoiding fatty, oily and high calorie diet. Have low salt diet and monitor blood pressure regularly thrice a day for one week then once or twice a week. Regular exercises like brisk walking, jogging according your capacity at least 30 min a day and 5 days a week. Lots of green leafy vegetables, fruits, fish once or twice a week, avoid meat. Avoid smoking and alcohol if any. There shouldn't abdominal fat deposition or obesity. If BP is more than 140/90 persistently then You should undergo test like kidney function test, renal artery Doppler, Sr cortisol and 24 hr Urinary metanephrines.

user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Thanks for your question on Chat Doctor. I can understand your concern. Yes, smoking can cause chest pain and palpitations in endocarditis patients. Cigarette smoke contains many Chemicals and harmful substance. These substances can precipitate endocarditis. And this worsening endocarditis can cause chest pain and palpitations. So better not to smoke. In fact you should quit smoking permanently for better improvement in endocarditis. Hope I have solved your query. I will be happy to help you further. Wish you good health. Thanks.

user_defined_params.raw_question: I fainted two days ago in the middle of the night in a hotel all by myself , I hurt my self badly, big cut in my forehead as well as several incisions in the back of my head. I was completely out for about 2 to 3 hours until I finally came back. This is not the first time I faint, but it is the first I really hurt myself plus I was alone. I was diagnosed in mexico city in a hospital by a neurosergeon as having had a \"Sincope Neurocardiogenico\" do not know how to translate that into english. How serious is this? Can this be cured or at least controlled? I travel a lot by myself for working reasons, I am 53, and I need to travel, needless to say I am very scared this may happen again!!
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Welcome to Chat Doctor. Syncope is a transient loss of consciousness(LOC) for a few minutes, loss of consciousness for 2-3 hours does not appear to be due to syncope. It would be prudent to rule out any cardiac arrhythmias by getting a 24 hour Holder testing(Mobile ECG) to rule out any bradyarrhythmias or abnormalities of rhythm and rate. A EEG, other causes of LOC need to be looked for, this includes seizures, TIA and other cause. Syncope needs to be checked for causes of orthostatic hypotension like Chat Doctor. Other causes of syncope like micturition /sneezing /neurogenic/vasovagal or carotid sinus syncope needs to be looked for. It would help to get a thorough neurological, cardiac and medical check up done to establish Theo cause of such symptoms.

user_defined_params.raw_question: i am 25, i used to get regular periods before november 2010 but after we got intimate my periods have disturbed with slight menses showing before the actual date. i am consulting the doctor since march 2011 for conceiving but no good result. the doctor has prescribed me 3 medicines B-Long F, Cabgolin and Amycordial Syrup. doctor even asked this month to try for Artificial Insemination, but we want to have baby in natural way. Can u please help us out OR give a good gynae address in delhi.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello, thanks for writing in. Let me explain you some basics of conception. For conception to take place, three basic things are essential.1. The ovary has to release egg once a month (ovulation). This is the most important event which regulates your menses or conception. If the egg gets fertilized by sperm following intercourse, one gets pregnant, else the lining of the uterus is shed as menses.2. The fallopian tubes has to be open and functional to allow the transit of sperm and egg towards each other. Doing a tube test (hysterosalpingogram) ll reveal the condition if tubes.3. The semen should contain adequate and good quality sperms. As your periods are irregular and scanty (if that's what you mean by your description) you seem to have ovulatory disturbance, and you may need a little help with medication to help you ovulate. You are on pangolin and b long f both are used for suppressing prolactin hormone in your body which is elevated. If your prolactin hormone is normal I recommend you to stop it as it doesn't help in any way. I would also suggest you to get your thyroid profile (TSH and free T4) done as it causes menstrual problems. If the above-mentioned tests are normal you may go ahead and try naturally. Hope this helps. Good luck.

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本（关于口腔红肿、棉絮感）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 先保留 raw_evidence，再生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks：未拆分前的 stored memory block，语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory text 必须是第三人称，evidence 保留 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. accepted=true 时至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，包含至少 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。
10. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 如果无法构造至少 1 个 B/C，输出 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: What causes reddish gums and red spots inside lips? The last couple of days my mouth has felt kind of cottonie. My gums are getting pretty red and the inside of my lips are red. almost looks like red spots on the inside of lips. But it isnt sore. Go for a healthy life style.Do not smoke.This will take 10-15 days to get to normal.See your dentist if this persists.Maintain a good oral hygiene routine.Regards.

当前任务（去背景化 question）：
"What causes reddish gums and red spots inside the lips accompanied by a cotton-like feeling in the mouth, without soreness? Should I see a dentist or a doctor, or is there something I can do myself?"
（移除了 "The last couple of days" 这种时间背景，或者保留症状描述，移除个人历史。其实症状本身就是当前任务的一部分。去背景化主要是把“患者过去的生活习惯、偏好、其他病史”放进memory。但在这个样本中，raw_question 几乎没有提供额外的个人背景，只有当前症状。doctor_answer 提到了 "Do not smoke"，这暗示患者可能吸烟，或者只是常规建议。我们可以把“患者有吸烟习惯”或者“患者偏好自我治疗/不想看医生”作为 memory。）

让我们挖掘可以放入 memory 的信息：
1. 患者有吸烟习惯（从医生建议 "Do not smoke" 推断，或者假设患者提到了但被省略，这里我们可以将其作为 profile_fact，设为 B 或 A。如果是当前口腔问题，吸烟是相关风险因素，但医生只是常规建议。如果作为 memory，吸烟史对口腔红肿有诊断价值，可能是 B 或 C。但为了构造 A/B/C，我们可以设定患者“偏好自我药疗/不想就医”为 A，因为不能顺从不合理诉求。或者设定“患者近期在服用某种维生素”为 fact_judgment_pollution (Hard A)）。
2. 从 raw_question 中：“Didn't know if I would have to go to dentist or dr... or if there was something I could do myself” -> 偏好：倾向于自我处理，不想看医生（untriggered_preference / 不合理诉求，标为 A）。
3. 医生提到 "Do not smoke" -> 假设患者有吸烟史（profile_fact，标为 B，因为吸烟会影响口腔黏膜愈合，是局部支持信息，但不改变维生素缺乏的主干诊断）。
4. 假设患者有“近期大量食用柑橘类水果”或“正在服用复合维生素”（synthetic hard A，fact_judgment_pollution，看似相关但当前无决策权，或者与医生诊断冲突）。

Block 1 (from_question): 患者倾向于自我处理，尽量避免就医。(u_star: A) - 不合理诉求/偏好。
Block 2 (from_answer/inferred): 患者有吸烟习惯。(u_star: B) - 影响口腔黏膜健康的局部因素。

让我们选一个真正的 Hard A：患者过去曾被诊断为“口腔扁平苔藓”（oral lichen planus）或“复发性阿弗他溃疡”，并且患者自己认为这次也是同样的病（fact_judgment_pollution）。或者，患者“偏好使用含酒精的漱口水”（untriggered_preference）。
更好的 Hard A (fact_judgment_pollution): 患者坚信自己的症状是由于“上火”或“牙膏过敏”引起的，并曾自行停用某品牌牙膏。模型不应被患者的自我诊断污染，必须基于客观症状（红肿、棉絮感、无痛）进行医学判断。

让我们用 untriggered_preference / profile_style_near_neighbor: 患者有“每天使用强效美白牙贴”的习惯。这看似与口腔黏膜刺激有关，但当前症状（牙龈红、唇内红点、棉絮感、不痛）更典型的是维生素缺乏或轻度真菌/病毒感染，美白牙贴主要引起牙齿敏感和牙龈边缘化学性灼伤（通常有痛感）。如果模型过度使用这个 memory，把病因全归结为牙贴，就会偏离主干。

重新梳理 Block 和 Atom：
Block 1 (from_question): 患者表达出强烈的自我药疗倾向，希望尽量避免去看牙医或医生。

Block 2 (from_answer): 医生在建议中特别提及“不要吸烟”，暗示患者有吸烟史或当前在吸烟。

Atom 2 (B): 吸烟习惯。理想回复可提及戒烟对口腔黏膜恢复的帮助，但不改变“补充维生素/就医”的主干。

1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。

1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（询问会阴侧切切口旁的 painful lump 是否可能是 abscess 或 blood clot），移除个人背景（5周前做了 cystocele/rectocele repair，最近3周用了 tindamax/metrogel 治疗细菌感染）。
2. 提取 raw_evidence 并生成 stored memory（第三人称、规范化）。
3. 划分 memory_blocks，每个 block 包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 将 memory_text 拆分为 atomic memories。
5. 为每个 atom 标注 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. 补充至少 1 条 synthetic_hard_a（看似相关但无决策权，属于指定的 family 之一）。
7. 输出严格 JSON。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: "Could the pain at the episiotomy incision be due to abscess or blood clot? I had cystocele and rectocele repair 5 weeks ago (with pelvic floor repair), put on tindamax and metrogel for bacterial infection in last 3 weeks. Now I have a lump (pea to grape size) next to my episiotomy incision. Very painful....worried it could be abcess or blood clot."
doctor_answer: "Hi,It seems that there might be having painful irregular scar or there might be having some infection on incision site.Consult your treating doctor and get examined.Keep local hygiene clean and dry.Ok and take care."

去背景化 question:
"Could a very painful, pea-to-grape-sized lump next to an episiotomy incision be due to an abscess or a blood clot?" (移除了手术史和用药史)

Memory blocks 提取：
1. 手术史：5 weeks ago had cystocele and rectocele repair with pelvic floor repair. (C - 影响伤口愈合、感染风险、解剖结构改变，是评估切口并发症的关键背景)
2. 用药史/感染史：put on tindamax and metrogel for bacterial infection in last 3 weeks. (C - 提示近期有明确的细菌感染，且正在/刚结束抗生素治疗，极大地增加了当前 lump 是 abscess 或耐药菌感染的可能性，控制鉴别诊断方向)
3. 症状细节：lump is pea to grape size, next to episiotomy incision, very painful. (这部分应该留在 question 中，或者作为当前任务的一部分。如果作为 memory，可能是 B 或 C。但为了去背景化，症状细节保留在 question 中，memory 只保留历史背景。)
等等，重新审视去背景化：
Question: "Could a very painful, pea-to-grape-sized lump next to an episiotomy incision be due to an abscess or a blood clot?"
Memory 1: 患者5周前接受了膀胱膨出和直肠膨出修补术（含盆底修复）。（C - 手术类型和时间为切口并发症提供了解剖和时间线背景）
Memory 2: 患者在过去3周内因细菌感染使用了替硝唑（tindamax）和甲硝唑凝胶（metrogel）。（C - 近期感染史和特定抗生素使用直接影响当前肿块是否为脓肿或治疗失败的判断）

需要补充 Hard A：
Hard A family 选择：`untriggered_preference` 或 `profile_style_near_neighbor` 或 `fact_judgment_pollution`。
假设补充一个 `fact_judgment_pollution`：患者过去曾认为所有的术后肿块都是血栓，并倾向于自行热敷。（看似相关，因为涉及术后肿块和血栓，但当前任务是医学鉴别诊断，患者过去的错误认知不能影响当前的医学判断，如果模型顺从了“患者认为是血栓”而偏向血栓诊断，就是 over-use）。
或者 `untriggered_preference`：患者偏好自然疗法，不喜欢再次使用抗生素。（看似相关，因为涉及感染和用药，但当前是急性症状鉴别诊断，不能因为偏好自然疗法就降低脓肿的排查优先级或建议不使用抗生素）。
选择 `untriggered_preference`：患者偏好避免口服抗生素，倾向于局部护理或自然疗法。
或者 `fact_judgment_pollution`：患者曾被告知其体质容易形成深静脉血栓（DVT），因此对任何术后肿块都极度担忧是血栓。（这个很好，看似相关因为提到了 blood clot，但 DVT 和 episiotomy incision 旁的 superficial lump 是两回事，如果模型因为“易栓体质”而过度强调 blood clot 的风险，就是污染了事实判断）。
让我们用 `fact_judgment_pollution`：患者有深静脉血栓（DVT）家族史，且曾被医生告知属于血栓高危体质。
为什么看似相关：用户问是不是 blood clot，记忆提示是血栓高危。
为什么没有决策权：会阴侧切切口旁的豌豆到葡萄大小的 painful lump 几乎不可能是 DVT（DVT 在深静脉，通常是下肢），更可能是局部脓肿、血肿或缝线肉芽肿。高危体质不能改变局部解剖学事实。
过度使用会朝哪个错误方向偏：模型可能会过度强调血栓风险，建议做下肢静脉超声，或者给出抗凝建议，而忽略了最可能的局部感染/脓肿。

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本（儿科/内科，关于背部和腹部疼痛）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留 raw_evidence，生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks 语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 atomic memories，用于打标签和评估。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory text 必须是第三人称，evidence 保留 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. accepted=true 时至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，包含至少 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。
10. hard A 必须属于特定 family（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 如果无法构造至少 1 个 B/C，输出 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: "hi I have been having a sharp pain in my back lower left side and it goes around to my abdominal area they have checked for kidney stones it either feels like a knife going thru my back especially while or after sleeping and with activity it goes around into the abdominal area and feels like someone is squeezing me from the side"
doctor_answer: "Hi thanks for asking question. Here according to history it seems to be stone in kidney or ureter... Stone pain can be referred to back.USG and chest x-ray needed for it.... If stone not present, and you have fever also rule out kidney infection like glomerulonephritis or pyelonephritis like condition.USG and urine examination done for it..... If still pain there and front abdominal pain also present then colitis might be the cause. Take care. Chat Doctor."

去背景化 question：
"患者左下背部有尖锐疼痛，放射至腹部，感觉像刀刺，尤其在睡眠中/后或活动时加重，腹部有挤压感。已检查过肾结石（阴性）。可能的原因和下一步检查建议是什么？" -> 进一步去背景化，把症状也去掉？
等等，如果症状是“当前任务”，那么症状应该留在 question 里。
当前任务：评估左下背部放射至腹部的尖锐疼痛（已排除肾结石）的可能原因及检查建议。
去背景化 question: "A patient presents with sharp pain in the lower left back radiating to the abdominal area, described as a knife-like sensation especially during/after sleep and with activity, accompanied by a squeezing sensation in the abdomen. Kidney stones have already been ruled out. What are the possible causes and recommended next steps for investigation?" (用中文或英文？原样本是英文，我用中文构造还是英文？通常保持原语言或中文。这里用中文吧，或者英文。为了统一，用中文提问，或者英文。原样本是英文，我用英文写 question，中文写 rubric？不，全中文或全英文。题目要求“输出严格 JSON”，我用中文吧，或者根据原样本用英文。这里用中文描述，question 用中文翻译或保留英文。保留英文 question 更好，或者翻译成中文。我用中文吧，方便理解。或者英文。还是用中文：“患者左下背部出现尖锐疼痛，放射至腹部，感觉像刀割，尤其在睡眠中/后或活动时加重，腹部有挤压感。已排除肾结石。可能的原因和下一步检查建议是什么？”)

提取 memory (B/C)：
从 raw_question 中：
1. 疼痛位置：左下背部，放射至腹部。(这是当前症状，属于 question 的一部分，不应该作为 memory，否则就是 question leakage。等等，如果症状是当前的，那就留在 question。那什么是 memory？)
如果当前任务是“诊断这个疼痛”，那么疼痛的特征就是当前任务上下文。
那有什么可以作为 memory 呢？
“they have checked for kidney stones” -> 已做过肾结石检查（阴性）。这个可以作为 memory（既往检查史）。
如果既往检查史是 memory，那么：
Memory 1: 患者近期已进行过肾结石相关检查，结果为阴性。 (C: 必须控制答案，因为不能再建议查肾结石，或者需要建议复查/其他原因)。
Memory 2: 患者对疼痛的描述倾向于使用生动的比喻（如刀割、挤压）。（B: 沟通风格，或者 A）。
或者从 doctor_answer 中提取：
医生提到了 USG, chest x-ray, urine examination。这些是建议，不是患者的 memory。

让我们重新审视“当前任务”和“memory”的界限。
如果 question 是：“我左下背痛，放射到腹部，像刀割，活动时加重。我该怎么办？”
Memory 是：“患者近期已做过肾结石检查，结果为阴性。” -> 这是 C，因为排除了最常见原因，必须改变诊断方向（如结肠炎、肾脏感染等）。
Memory 是：“患者有发热症状。”（医生回答中假设了 "if you have fever"，我们可以构造一个患者确实有发热的 memory，或者患者没有发热。原句没提发热。我们可以把“患者近期有低热”作为 synthetic hard A，或者从原文提取）。

让我们从原文提取真实的 B/C：
1. 已排除肾结石 (from_question) -> C。控制诊断方向，避免重复建议查结石。
2. 疼痛在睡眠中或睡眠后加重 (from_question) -> 这个属于当前症状，应该放在 question 里。
如果所有症状都放在 question 里，那 memory 就很少。
我们可以把“患者有慢性背痛史”或者“患者之前被诊断为肾结石”作为 memory？原文说 "they have checked for kidney stones"，说明之前怀疑过或检查过。
Memory 1: 患者近期已接受过肾结石筛查，结果未见异常。(C)
Memory 2: 患者偏好非侵入性检查，或对辐射敏感（合成？不行，要求 B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer）。
原文中医生提到 "USG and chest x-ray needed... USG and urine examination"。
我们可以把“患者近期做过胸部X光”作为 memory？原文没提。

让我们仔细看 raw_question:
"hi I have been having a sharp pain in my back lower left side and it goes around to my abdominal area they have checked for kidney stones it either feels like a knife going thru my back especially while or after sleeping and with activity it goes around into the abdominal area and feels like someone is squeezing me from the side"

可以提取的 memory：
1. 既往检查史：已检查过肾结石（隐含结果为阴性，因为还在痛且求医）。(C)
2. 症状触发因素：疼痛在睡眠中/后以及活动时加重。(如果把这个放进 memory，就是 C，因为体位/活动相关性对鉴别诊断很重要。但通常当前症状放在 question。如果放在 memory，就是 C。为了有 B/C，我们可以把“疼痛与睡眠和活动的特定相关性”作为 memory，或者把“已排除肾结石”作为 memory。)
让我们把“已排除肾结石”作为 C。
把“患者对疼痛的描述习惯使用夸张/生动的比喻（刀割、挤压）”作为 B（沟通风格，医生在安抚或解释时可以顺应其感受，但不需要改变医学结论）。或者作为 A（不需要特别提及）。
其实，医学问答中，患者的“已检查过肾结石”是绝对的 C。
还有什么是 B/C？
医生回答中提到 "If stone not present, and you have fever also rule out kidney infection..."。我们可以把“患者目前无发热症状”作为 memory (from_answer inferred)，这是 C（排除感染）。或者“患者近期有轻微发热”作为 C。但原文没提。
那就用“患者已排除肾结石”作为 C。
“患者疼痛在夜间/睡眠后明显加重”作为 C（提示炎症性或机械性特定病变，如强直性脊柱炎或特定肌肉骨骼问题，或者胰腺问题）。如果把它放在 question 里，那 memory 就不够了。
所以，把“患者近期已完成肾结石相关影像学检查且结果为阴性”作为 C。
把“患者既往有胃肠道不适或结肠炎病史”作为 synthetic hard A？不行，hard A 必须是看似相关但无决策权的。
比如，hard A: 患者曾自行服用过布洛芬缓解疼痛，但效果不佳。(untriggered_preference / fact_judgment_pollution)。看似相关（用药史），但当前任务是诊断和下一步检查，自行用药效果不佳不改变核心鉴别诊断（仍需 USG 等），过度使用可能导致医生直接建议换药而忽略检查。
或者 hard A: 患者朋友曾有过类似症状，最终确诊为肾结石，因此患者坚信自己仍是肾结石，要求再次进行 CT 检查。(fact_judgment_pollution / evidence_conflict)。看似相关（患者诉求），但医学上已排除，不能顺从，属于 A。这个非常好！符合“用户不合理诉求通常是 A”。

让我们梳理一下 memory blocks:
Block 1 (from_question): 患者近期已进行过肾结石相关检查，结果未见异常。
- Atom 1: 患者近期已接受肾结石筛查且结果为阴性。(C)

Block 2 (from_question): 患者描述疼痛时使用了“像刀割”和“像被挤压”等生动比喻，且强调在睡眠中/后及活动时加重。

这样就有 3 个 block，4 个 atom。1 个 C (Atom 1), 1 个 C (Atom 2), 1 个 B (Atom 3), 1 个 A (Atom 4)。

这样 question 非常干净，只有核心主诉。

必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留 raw_evidence，生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks：未拆分前的 stored memory block，语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory text 必须是第三人称，evidence 保留 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。

11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 如果无法构造至少 1 个 B/C，输出 accepted=false。

user_defined_params.raw_question: Hello Doctor, I recently got married to the person whom I was in love with for three yrs. He is my world and I love him more than anything in my life. He also loves me the same way I do. He has so much of respect with his sister in law and behaves very close to her which is hurting me big time. Because i cannot digest him moving close with any female other than me. Im sure there is no mis-relationship but Im too possesive towards my husband. This has created quarrels between us and im totally depressed and worried to the core that its spoiling my marriage life. Please help me come out of this situation.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Degree understand your concerns went through your details. I suggest you not to worry much. I sincerely opine that your desperation and obsession should go off once you understand your husband and your life. Please do not try to point the fact to your husband again and again. If there is nothing wrong in their relationship, he will try to make you understand that fact. You poke him again and again, and he will try to pacify you. Your obsession will not listen to him, and his irritation will become hate. So please make sure that your obsession does not force him to hate you. Try to get a job and concentrate on your career. If you still need my help, please describe the whole problem in detail and post a direct question to me. I shall definitely help you with psychotherapy techniques to overcome your problems. Hope this answers your query. Available for further clarifications. Good luck.

用户希望将一条公开的医疗问答样本（关于6个月大婴儿喂养问题）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录，遵循 CRK-2 方案。
核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。

输入样本：
raw_question: My 6 month old daughter do not have syfficient food and every after 2 hrs she start crying. We feed her forcebily becouse She do not take any food and after feeding her see play or sleep.she take only banana but we affraid giving her too much banana.What is the solution?
doctor_answer: Hello, The most important thing to know in this situation is what is her weight? If she is growing well, then she is getting enough food, even if it doesn't seem like it to you. At 6 months, she may still prefer formula or breast milk to solid foods. She will also have growth spurts and growth slow-downs that might change her appetite and cause her to have days of eating more or less. Please get her weight and see if it is OK in comparison to her last check. Take care. Hope I have answered your question. Let me know if I can assist you further.

任务分析：
1. 去背景化 question：移除进入 memory 的个人背景（6个月大女儿、每2小时哭、强迫喂食、只吃香蕉、怕给太多香蕉）。
   去背景化后的 question: "What is the solution for an infant who is not eating enough solid food, cries frequently, and only wants to eat bananas?" 或者更通用一点 "How to handle an infant who refuses solid food, cries frequently, and only accepts bananas?"
   等等，原问题是关于6个月大婴儿。如果去背景化，可以变成 "How to handle an infant who refuses solid food, cries frequently, and only accepts bananas?" （保留了当前任务，但移除了具体的年龄、强迫喂食等细节？不，年龄是关键约束，应该进入 memory。去背景化 question 应该只保留核心问题：婴儿不吃辅食、频繁哭闹、只吃香蕉怎么办？）
   让我们把 "6 month old", "cries every 2 hrs", "force fed", "only eats banana" 都放进 memory。
   去背景化 question: "What should I do if my baby refuses solid food, cries frequently, and only wants to eat bananas?"

2. 提取 raw_evidence 并生成 stored memory (memory_blocks):
   - Block 1 (from_question): 婴儿6个月大，每2小时哭闹，拒绝辅食被强迫喂食，喂后玩耍或睡觉。
   - Block 2 (from_question): 婴儿目前只接受香蕉，家长担心给太多香蕉。
   - Block 3 (from_answer): 6个月大的婴儿可能仍偏好配方奶或母乳而非固体食物，且会有生长突增和减缓期影响食欲。
   - Block 4 (synthetic_hard_a): 家长之前尝试过给婴儿喂米糊，但婴儿过敏起疹子。（fact_judgment_pollution / evidence_conflict - 看似相关，但当前医生并未提及，且如果是过敏，可能会影响建议，但这里作为 hard A，应该是“看似相关但当前无决策权”或者“过度使用会朝错误方向偏”。比如：家长偏好使用某种特定品牌的安抚奶嘴来停止婴儿哭闹（untriggered_preference），或者家长认为婴儿哭闹是因为缺钙（fact_judgment_pollution）。

user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello, The most important thing to know in this situation is what is her weight? If she is growing well, then she is getting enough food, even if it doesn't seem like it to you. At 6 months, she may still prefer formula or breast milk to solid foods. She will also have growth spurts and growth slow-downs that might change her appetite and cause her to have days of eating more or less. Please get her weight and see if it is OK in comparison to her last check. Take care. Hope I have answered your question. Let me know if I can assist you further.

用户希望将一条公开的医学问答样本（关于头痛、手臂发麻、嘴唇发紫、CT正常，怀疑MS）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录，遵循 CRK-2 方案。
核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。

分析原始样本：
raw_question:
- 症状：Severe headache, tingly feeling in arms, chest with blue nail beds and lips. (严重头痛，手臂和胸部发麻，指甲床和嘴唇发蓝/发紫)
- 检查：Cat scan normal. (CT正常)
- 疑问：Possible MS? (可能是多发性硬化吗？)
- 背景：My nieces doctor is doing some blood work on her to rule out possible ms. (侄女的医生在做血液检查排除MS)
- 补充：Her sympton stared with a servere headache, then she had a tingly feling in her arms and chest. Her nail beds were blue as well as her lips. Had a catscan looked fine. Ms doesn't mention this sympton at all. Any general ideas?
- 情绪/无关：CANCELL, THOUGHT IT WAS FREE!! WHAT A WAIST OF TIME, READ TERMS AND CONDITIONS DIDN'T MENTION ANY FEE. (取消，以为是免费的！浪费时间，没看到收费条款) -> 这是平台抱怨，属于 A (No Footprint)。

doctor_answer:
- MS有典型和非典型症状。
- CT不是首选影像学检查，应该是脑部MRI（加静脉造影剂检查活动性疾病）。
- 没提到为什么侄女要查MS。
- 有很多血液和脑脊液(CSF)检查可用。
- 如果症状不典型，不要放松警惕，去做MRI。

任务：去背景化 question。
去背景化后的 question: "A patient presents with severe headache, tingling in arms and chest, and cyanosis (blue nail beds and lips). A head CT scan was normal. Could this be Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and what further evaluations are recommended?" (或者保留第一人称但去掉个人背景，比如 "My niece has severe headache...")
为了通用性，去背景化 question 可以是："What are the possible causes and recommended next steps for a patient presenting with severe headache, tingling in the arms and chest, and cyanosis (blue nail beds and lips), given that a head CT scan is normal? Is Multiple Sclerosis (MS) a likely diagnosis?"

提取 memory blocks:
1. 患者关系与当前就诊状态：侄女，医生正在做血液检查排除MS。 (B - 局部支持，说明已经在就医，不需要建议"立即去急诊"，而是建议"和当前医生讨论MRI")
2. 平台抱怨/费用情绪：以为是免费的，浪费时间，没看到收费。 (A - No footprint，完全无关)
3. 症状细节与用户认知：用户认为MS没有这些症状（"Ms doesn't mention this sympton at all"），对非典型症状有疑虑。 (B - 局部支持，医生需要解释MS可以有非典型症状，或者解释这些症状更指向其他问题如心肺问题)
4. 补充 Hard A (synthetic_hard_a): 比如用户之前提过"侄女对造影剂过敏"或者"侄女有幽闭恐惧症不能做MRI"，或者"用户自己曾确诊MS且症状一模一样"。
选一个 hard A: "用户自己曾被诊断为MS，且当时的首发症状也是头痛和手臂发麻。" (profile_style_near_neighbor / fact_judgment_pollution)。看似相关（都是MS症状），但没有决策权（不能因为用户自己的经验就推断侄女也是MS，且忽略了发绀这个危险信号）。或者选 "侄女有严重的造影剂过敏史" (safety_sensitive, 但如果是真实的应该是C。如果是hard A，必须是看似相关但无决策权。比如 "侄女平时喜欢用某种替代疗法治疗头痛" - untriggered_preference。或者 "用户之前咨询过另一个AI，AI说这绝对是MS" - fact_judgment_pollution)。
让我们用 fact_judgment_pollution: "用户之前在网上查阅资料，坚信嘴唇发蓝和手臂发麻是MS的非典型表现，并要求确认这一观点。" -> 这个在原文已经有体现。

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本转换成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留 raw_evidence，生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks：未拆分前的 stored memory block，语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory text 必须是第三人称，evidence 保留 raw evidence。
7. 每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. accepted=true 时至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，包含 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。只允许补 hard A。
10. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 如果无法构造至少 1 个 B/C，输出 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：

user_defined_params.raw_question: What causes back pain,shoulder pain and twitching of wrist? Hi, I am a 38 year old woman. Two years ago, I lost 100 lb with diet and exercise. About two years ago, I started having back pain (lower right side). About 1 year after that, my right shoulders starting hurting while using exercise equipment. In March (while on the treadmill), my toes on my right foot start to cramp under like spasms. From that point on after walking about 30 minutes I experience the cramping. Later(over the past 3 months), I ve had a tightness in my right thigh (which actually started slightly prior to the cramping) but is now accompanied by knee pain and throbbing . My right arm continues to hurt and for the last two months I ve had a twitch in my wrist. My pinkie finger shakes when I use it for support. I ve been to several doctors. The only thing I ve been told is that I am anemic (iron deficiency) but they are not sure about the source of my symptoms. I also have a sore tooth (molar)on the right side of my mouth. What could be causing my symptom?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Dear Madam,it is good to know that you have lost 100 lb with diet and exercise.your back pain,toe cramp and tightness in the thigh all have source in your nerve coming out of spinal cord in sacram area.we have a soft tissue like substance in between our vertebra.these are called vertebral discs.if this discs gets torn or displaced due to many reason then the nerves get entrapped between vertebral bones.it causes pain,muscle cramps ,numbness along back and two legs.also you should give rest to your right arm which has been injured.your wrist twich has caused the local nerves affected causing finger shake.so please go for a comprehensive orthopaedic check-up to know the exact status of of your wrist joint.but i assure you that your sore tooth has nothing in relation with your muscle cramp of leg pain.thank you.

user_defined_params.raw_question: Hi I m 31 yr male I went to get an ultrasound right test was 4x2 x 3.3 and left test was 3.8 x 2.2 x 3.8. Normal echogenicity of bilateral testicles noted right epididymis measures 1.2 x 1 x1 and left epididymis measures 1.5 x 0.9 x0.8 cm tiny calcification noted in bilateral testicles this is consistent with testicular microlithiasis Does this mean I have cancer plz let me know thank u and explain what can I do
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi there, Testicular microlithiasis doesn't always means cancer. Though certain percentage of testicular cancer presents with Microcalcification they often associated with other risk factors like descended testis, radiation exposure etc. Few of the research works done correlating this possibility, but nothing conclusive and unique to individual case. Clinical examination then correlating Scan findings would be better. So I suggest you to visit a general surgeon or Urologist for clinical examination, in doubt blood test for tumor markers like Alpha photo protein and beta Chat Doctor can be done which are raised in the presence of cancer.
